rows.description: CVAT is a leading data annotation platform for image, video, audio, and 3D datasets. It offers open-source, cloud, and enterprise products, as well as labeling services, with AI-assisted labeling, quality assurance, team collaboration, analytics, and developer APIs.
Download video and audio from 1000+ sites, transcribe locally with speaker labels, and summarize, translate, or chat with your media using your preferred AI provider.
Cutting edge AI technology for automated audio transcription. A nice GUI for OpenAIs Whisper and pyannote (speaker identification)
